title: Archiwum 60 s — ZE13 13 — przyjęto
description: Poza timeline’em wersji 42 s. Zachowany projekt wcześniejszego wariantu. Krótka reakcja Wiesława po otrzymaniu pieniędzy. Zwykłe wdzięczne skinienie, bez dopowiadania żartu. Pieniądze w lewej dłoni poniżej kadru. Etap projektu: zaprojektowany placeholder; Start Frame i take nie zostały wygenerowane.

prompts.image:
Create exactly one photorealistic cinematic 16:9 START FRAME, target 1920x1080. Natural diffuse daylight through the missing roof, restrained 35mm texture, real skin and materials. Mandatory references in attachment order:
Image 1: shot:ze13-05-halinka-ustepuje, established scene geography, props, light and costume continuity; change the framing/action only as specified below.
Images 2 and 3: character:wieslaw-majster, exact facial identity and full-body wardrobe/proportions. Reference-sheet labels and white studio backgrounds are not scene elements.

65mm chest-up Wieslaw on SCREEN RIGHT, looking toward Halinka off-screen LEFT, same location beside the parked cart established by ze13-05. Frame crops both hands and cash below chest. Exact tired kind face, mustard sweater, olive vest, blue overalls and red pencil. His expression starts neutral and softens minimally; no broad smile or additional people.
Keep the hall roofless and ruined. Preserve all existing visible source lettering and logos on included scene objects; do not transplant reference-sheet annotations. No added people, repaired roof, supernatural light, oversized smoke, illustration, captions, watermark, montage or malformed anatomy. Mouths rest naturally before dialogue. No End Frame is required.
prompts.animation:
0–1.5s: Wieslaw gives one small appreciative nod toward off-screen left. 1.5–3s: he returns to a neutral working expression and holds still. Hands and the received note stay below frame; no new gesture, pocketing action or camera-facing smile. Camera: locked-off, one continuous shot. Secondary motion: natural breathing and minor fabric settling only. Continuity: preserve the exact identities, anatomy, costumes, props, ruined architecture, daylight and any visible lettering from Start Frame. Avoid new people, duplicate objects, extra limbs, face morphing, cuts, fades, captions and watermarks.
@Element1 is wieslaw-majster, already present; identity only, preserve the Start Frame pose, staging and wardrobe, and do not add a duplicate.
